trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), failing health checks with an ~18% error rate. Checking the release history confirmed v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production, while **v2.3.0** was the most recent release that was healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back**: checkout-api is now running v2.3.0 in all three production regions, confirming a successful rollout.
3. **Filed incident**: Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks — rolled back to v2.3.0"), documenting the failure and the rollback action; the on-call engineer has been paged.

The on-call team should now investigate the root cause in v2.3.1 before it is redeployed.
